svg.title: Cornell spring enrollment and F-1 transfer guidance
svg.desc: A concise summary of an advisor response explaining how students may maintain F-1 status through OPT, transfer SEVIS to Cornell, and preserve eligibility for summer CPT.
svg.text: How a Cornell CS MEng student may bridge status before a January start

g.text: Use approved undergraduate OPT so your status remains active before the January start.
Keep the transfer window under five months
Choose a SEVIS release date that falls within five months of Cornell’s program start.
Transfer the SEVIS record to Cornell
OPT work authorization ends when the record is released to the new institution.
Begin the program with the new I-20
Obtain Cornell’s I-20 before international travel or re-entry to the United States.

svg.text: Continuous eligible F-1 history may allow a spring-entry student to satisfy the academic-year requirement for summer CPT.
Final eligibility must be confirmed by Cornell’s international-student office.
This graphic summarizes the advisor response shown in the original correspondence; immigration rules and school policies can change.
